summary: This directory serves as an interface layer for Material UI form components. It centralizes the implementation of standardized form interaction elements, ensuring consistent behavior and styling across the application's user interface while abstracting underlying component library logic.
responsibilities: Provide reusable form-related UI components using Material UI
Manage visual states for form submission actions
relationships: The UI adapter layer translates application-level form requirements into specific Material UI component implementations.
Submit buttons react to form submission states to provide visual feedback to the user.
designDecisions: Implementation of an adapter pattern to decouple the UI from specific library dependencies.
Encapsulation of component library primitives within specialized wrappers.
